glomeris status — Current disk-pressure state and the thresholds behind it.

usage: glomeris status [--json]

Read-only — changes nothing.

Reads the filesystem's free space and reports which pressure state that falls
into, together with the thresholds used to decide. Runs no detectors, so it is
fast and says nothing about individual resources.

Options
  --json
      Print a StatusReport as JSON on stdout instead of prose.

Examples
  glomeris status
      Is anything wrong right now?

See also: detect, history
